Input checkpoints were saved in [run 12845](runs/00012845-floodplain/plate.webp).

- 15,753,459 units came from floats at least three sites from their origin.
- 13,032 residents expressed a nonidentity pigment mapping.

The river encountered 81,313,016 wet, supplied high banks. On 10,711,878 pulses, water overtopped a bank and released 46,332,430 units of food. The animals swallowed 1,285,587 units from those pulses and 7,444,550 from shallow trickles.

Input checkpoints were saved in [run 09585](runs/00009585-talk/plate.webp), [run 09648](runs/00009648-floodplain/plate.webp).

- Muting the reports left 2,094 correct spoken decisions.
- The listener consumed 12,252 measured units of sediment carbon on the probes.

A copy of the speaker requested one of two local measurements on each of 4,096 held-out reaches. After the spring moved, 2,042 spoken instructions named the stocked pan and were decoded by the worker. Removing the cited source changed the public decision in 2,080 physically verified explanations.

Input checkpoints were saved in [run 09812](runs/00009812-floodplain/plate.webp).

## 07861 · A first choice in unfamiliar water

Completed 2026-11-22T03:47:39Z · [WebP plate](runs/00007861-floodplain/plate.webp) · [Creature card](runs/00007861-floodplain/creature-card.webp) · [Summary](runs/00007861-floodplain/summary.json) · [Observations](runs/00007861-floodplain/observations.json.gz)

- Both copies saw the same query in opposite solvents.
- Each allowed up to 9 exposures with other coatings.

Cloned residents made 65,536 paid first choices about a coating absent from their reference samples. After observing other coatings, 32,758 choices paid off in the actual bath. Freezing their synapses gave 32,768 productive choices, and showing the opposite bath gave 32,778.

## 07655 · What the watershed taught

- Contact choices were correct on 9,104 trials.
- Untouched and insulated twins registered 0 and 0 reactions.

Residents chose a productive soil in 9,168 of 16,384 choices on unfamiliar ground. Their own experience supported 57 productive builds, including 50 requiring two displaced pieces. Clearing their acquired contacts and motor memories left 8 productive builds in the same trials.

Each of 512 beds opened with every grain isolated and its two deposits 3 steps from the light. After the builder left, 4 beds made food from a cold start, including 2 with at least two individually necessary relocated grains. Silencing spatial propagation left 0 working beds in the same population.

- Clearing acquired contacts gave 16,229 correct choices out of 65,536.
- 101,840 successful or failed bites shared their digestion slot with earlier material.

1,024 juveniles learned on crops with independent, unfamiliar opening rules. They chose the right muscle on 59,935 of 65,536 held-out appearances and on 52,049 after a reversal. Juveniles receiving another animal’s digestive signals chose correctly 16,148 times in the first test.

## 04607 · Every possible three-object map

Input checkpoints were saved in [run 04593](runs/00004593-talk/plate.webp).

- 472,392 queries had no destination and 413,343 had several possibilities or a missing branch.
- The tested reference sequence was 6 on directed ports zero through seven.

## 04605 · A season on changing currents

Completed 2026-11-21T12:38:30Z · [WebP plate](runs/00004605-commons/plate.webp) · [Summary](runs/00004605-commons/summary.json) · [Observations](runs/00004605-commons/observations.json.gz)

Input checkpoints were saved in [run 04599](runs/00004599-infer/plate.webp).

- 64 residents settled on a meaning for the 8-crossing food cue.
- 1,024 tidal events updated acquired contacts during the season.

The island currents changed every day while 64 newborns competed for food. Residents placed 4,096 traps and reached the right destination 3,726 times. They obtained 2,899 meals and deposited 12,984 energy units in offspring.

## 04201 · Every partial view of a world

Completed 2026-11-21T10:32:36Z · [WebP plate](runs/00004201-conjoin/plate.webp) · [Summary](runs/00004201-conjoin/summary.json) · [Observations](runs/00004201-conjoin/observations.json.gz)

Input checkpoints were saved in [run 04073](runs/00004073-conjoin/plate.webp).

- The external scorer considered all 576 possible four-bearing Latin squares for every history.
- One fixed sequence of demonstrations per physical law determined the order of each subset.

The animal inferred 225.7M of 229.3M bearings uniquely determined within the tested family. It remained silent on 70.3M of 72.7M ambiguous questions. It gave an incorrect bearing on 356,847 forced questions and 2,339,012 ambiguous ones.

## 04195 · Predicting an unseen arrangement

## 03085 · A million independent visual histories

Completed 2026-11-21T07:56:58Z · [WebP plate](runs/00003085-attention/plate.webp) · [Summary](runs/00003085-attention/summary.json) · [Observations](runs/00003085-attention/observations.json.gz)

Input checkpoints were saved in [run 02991](runs/00002991-attention/plate.webp).

- Direct median 5.68 billion decisions per second.
- 67.1M correct integrated sensory decisions in the final run.

Each of 1,048,576 pairs received its own stream of words, cues and sightings. The direct and compiled circuits produced the same activity checksum across 67.1M decisions. The compiled circuit made 24.12 billion source selections and visual updates per second.

- Final population 527 across 1,024 sites.

The thicket went from 417 to 527 living animals in 65,536 simulated ticks. The observed interval records 145,700 births, 145,590 deaths and 11.3M moves. The deepest resident lineage spans 627 divisions, with 1 surviving founder line in the habitat.

## 03075 · Choosing between sight and memory

Completed 2026-11-21T07:50:32Z · [WebP plate](runs/00003075-attention/plate.webp) · [Summary](runs/00003075-attention/summary.json) · [Observations](runs/00003075-attention/observations.json.gz)

Input checkpoints were saved in [run 02991](runs/00002991-attention/plate.webp).

- Reversing the transmitted pitch produced 0 correct revised sequences.
- Shuffling food feedback gave 3 correct revised sequences.

The caller learned a local pitch convention and requested the intended source on 16 of 16 single-word trials. Before reassignment the pairs followed 16 complete sequences of 8 words. After the word meanings changed they correctly executed 16 of 16 sequences.
